verdict.rationale: iTerm2 is a local macOS terminal emulator with no vendor-hosted or cloud version, so "self-host the core product" is a deployment question that does not fit this kind of product. The app already runs entirely on the user's own Mac, so there is no hosted-versus-self-hosted choice to evaluate. The configurable AI endpoint is a user-side workaround for the optional AI plugin, not self-hosting of the core product.
